summary: Ouster, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million of common stock. The filing is a routine capital-raising through a shelf registration statement; no special-situation event (e.g., tender offer, going-private, spin-off) is present. The company is the issuer using agents as sales conduits under Rule 415(a)(4).
